title: Fall Asleep to the Book of Psalms | KJV Bible Audio for Deep Sleep | 8 Hours, Black Screen
description:
The complete Book of Psalms from the King James Version, read slowly and softly for sleep.

All 150 Psalms, start to finish. No verse numbers, no music swells, no volume spikes. Soft rain sits low underneath the whole way through. The screen goes dark after the first minute so it won't light up your room, and the reading fades out gently at the end instead of stopping cold.

Made for anyone who wants the Word playing while they rest: night owls, early risers, shift workers sleeping through the day, and anyone whose mind won't settle.

"I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety." Psalm 4:8 (KJV)

Tip: turn off Autoplay (the switch at the bottom of the player) so nothing else starts when the reading ends.

Scripture: King James Version (public domain).
Narration: AI-generated voice, produced and mastered by our team.
